_comment: Item definitions. category: material | lootbox | placeable | source | structure. Materials follow the cosmology: hydrogen and helium are primordial, while carbon and iron only come out of collapsing caches for now. Items with a lootTable can be opened with the Use action. Items with stackSize 1 get a unique instance id. Enclosures (placeable with maxExposureStacks > 0) hold one loot box and one radiation source; sources name a radiation id from radiation.json. Structures are part of the pocket universe: actions create them in grid cells and they can't be recalled. An overdensity (structure with maxAmplitude > 0) yields the current epoch's yieldTable every yieldSeconds, one roll per amplitude. The loot_box item is shown to players as the Quantum Cache (ids keep the old name).

items.tooltip: Primordial hydrogen: a lone proton, and three quarters of all the matter there will ever be.
Primordial helium, fused in the first few minutes. A quarter of all the matter there will ever be.
Forged when three helium nuclei fuse. No star has shone yet, so only the crush inside a collapsing cache is enough to make it.
The end of the fusion road: fusing iron costs energy instead of releasing it. Only the most compressed caches collapse this far.

Primordial gas crushed into a sealed cache in superposition: what's inside isn't decided until it's observed. Use it to open it and collapse it. The crush fuses some of the gas into carbon and, rarely, iron.

A quantum ripple stretched to cosmic size. It's a little denser than its surroundings, so it gathers whatever matter the epoch has to offer and sends it through the horizon link to you. Each amplitude adds a roll to its yield.
A light, graphite-lined radiation chamber. Contains radiation up to tier 4 (microwaves). Holds one quantum cache and one source.
A heavy steel-plated radiation chamber. Contains any radiation up to tier 7 (gamma). Holds one quantum cache and one source.
A broad-spectrum lamp. Visible light drives photosynthesis: caches yield more carbon.
Heats and cures what it shines on: caches get extra rolls.
Ore extraction: caches yield more iron.
Observation: collapses a cache early. Its contents are revealed and fixed, and nothing changes it after that.
Mutation: caches may collapse into more caches. Needs an iron enclosure.
